verdict.rationale: Discord's developer platform exposes a broad REST/Gateway API, OAuth2, webhooks, slash commands, interactions, and a Social SDK covering messaging, presence, and account linking, showing substantial API coverage of bot/integration functionality. However, this coverage is aimed at building bots/apps rather than giving an end-user full parity with everything doable in the Discord client (e.g., no evidence of API-equivalent actions for Nitro subscription features, personal account social actions, or general UI-only settings), and the probe confirms no discoverable OpenAPI spec, suggesting the API surface isn't exhaustively documented for 1:1 parity. missing for 10: evidence of full end-user (non-bot) API parity for all client actions, an official OpenAPI/spec confirming complete surface coverage, and independent confirmation that no UI action lacks an API equivalent.
